source.source_locator: 教則 第3章 3.1.2(5)2)「技能証明の資格要件」（教則表示ページ28 / PDF viewer 33）

evidence.answer_defining_proposition: 16歳に満たない者は無人航空機操縦者技能証明を申請できない。
evidence.tested_misconception: 技能証明は試験に合格できれば年齢にかかわらず申請できる。
evidence.reasoning_path: applicant -> age qualification gate -> application eligibility

collision.note: Tier A。Q109は技能証明の更新時期を問う。申請時の最低年齢ゲートは未出。

independent_review.rationale: 3.1.2(5)2) explicitly bars applicants under 16 from applying for a UAS pilot skill certificate. No current canonical item tests the minimum-age application gate.

director_adjudication.rationale: The independent review correctly applies the quality-preserving 400-question contract to the B7 Chapter 3 Rules set. All 15 Tier A candidates test explicit source propositions not represented by the current 215-question accepted/source-verified canonical bank. The five Tier B candidates C001, C003, C008, C013 and C015 remain materially distinct through source-defined flight-phase, authority/exception, operation-subtype, response-sequence or moving-vehicle boundaries. None is retained as wording-only variation, none relies on a subsection marked 〔一等〕, and none is accepted merely to fill a numeric quota.
